access.notes: Standard wurtzite ZnO lattice parameters. Available from public crystallographic databases (e.g., Materials Project mp-2133) or from the literature. Used to construct nanowire atomic models.
Open-source DFT package used as the alternative to the original DMol³ code.

resources.name: Noriega et al. (2010) experimental conductivity data

access.notes: J. Appl. Phys. 107, 074312. Provides the baseline experimental electrical conductivity σ = 384.6 (Ω·cm)⁻¹ at carrier concentration n = 8.8×10¹⁹ cm⁻³ and T = 300 K, used to fit the relaxation time.
Thin Solid Films 516, 4620-4627. Contains the empirical relation between electron mobility and carrier concentration for ZnO thin films, used to scale the relaxation time τ(n).
Nanotechnology 18, 435706. Reports phonon thermal conductivities for ZnO nanowires of similar diameter: κ_ph(W) = 8.3 W/m·K, κ_ph(H) = 10.1 W/m·K. These constants are used in the ZT calculation.
